categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Has the Validation label and alters UTXO script decompression error handling in src/compressor.h.
categories.rationale: Prevents silent corruption from turning unspendable UTXOs into anyone-can-spend scripts by throwing a deserialization error on decompression failure. As noted in the description, `ScriptCompression::Unser` ignored `DecompressScript` failure, meaning that under data corruption 'an unspendable off-curve P2PK turns into an anyone-can-spend empty script', violating chainstate integrity.
